purpose: Initial cold burst exposed DB waiter exhaustion; retained failed diagnostic.

limitations: Small local HTTP-only samples; p95/p99 are observations, not production SLO certification.
Fixed 24-source bursts with limits active; higher traffic, browsers, CDN/assets and distributed instances need separate testing.
Resource maxima are sampled. Cache reset uses an acknowledged private IPC barrier; no reset API is exposed.

monitoring.networkScope: Observed loopback HTTP socket bytes, including headers; not NIC/WAN or database protocol bandwidth.

dataset.assumption: Local expected-use planning baseline; not a measured production forecast.

checks: critical writes confined to fixture DB
